events.title: Wolf in Woof — Steam Next Fest Gameplay Showcase
events.summary: 🐺 A pack of dogs. Hidden wolves. Who's the best liar?Welcome to the Wolf in Woof Steam Next Fest Gameplay Showcase!Wolf in Woof is a single-player Werewolf game where you face off against a pack of AI-powered dogs, each with a personality of their own!No teammates needed. No voice chat required. Just you, a table full of suspicious pups, and a whole lot of hilarious accusations, clever bluffs, and unexpected betrayals!🐾 Special Thanks & Video CreditA huge thank-you to Bilibili creator 沐沐才不是木头呢 f

events.title: Wolf in Woof Demo Fix Notice: We’re Improving the Experience
events.summary: Hello, dog detectives!Thank you so much for playing the Wolf in Woof Demo over the past few days. We also want to thank every player who took the time to share issues, suggestions, and feedback with us.We have received several recurring points of feedback about the current Demo, including:1. The reasoning and counter-reasoning behavior of the dog NPCs still needs improvement;2. The match flow may occasionally behave incorrectly;3. Some intermittent logic issues may occur;4.
